title: Input formats and outputs
text: data frame (tibble) one row per observation. Expression normalized (e.g. log-normalized, depth-corrected) numeric value; centred scaled internally. Non-finite values drop row. Context columns: numeric = continuous (e.g. leading principal components computed within cell type, pseudotime, activation score); factor/character = categorical (cell type, subtype, treatment). Numeric context standardized. Covariates enter main effects . Use cell-level covariates (library size, PCs expression, batch) donor-level covariates (age, sex, genetic PCs). Categorical covariates one-hot encoded “level” component. Donor IDs must match genetic input exactly (character comparison); donors without genotypes rows missing values dropped message.

title: Model
text: Let \(y_{im}\) normalized expression gene cell \(m\) individual \(\) (\(=1,\dots,n\); \(m=1,\dots,M_i\)), \(g_i\\mathbb{R}^p\) standardized cis-genotypes (default SNPs within ±500 kb gene), \(c_{im}\\mathbb{R}^K\) cell-state features (example leading within-cell-type principal components) \(o_{im}\\mathbb{R}^L\) covariates. \[ y_{im}= g_i^\top\beta + (g_i\otimes c_{im})^\top\gamma + c_{im}^\top\alpha + o_{im}^\top\eta + e_i + \varepsilon_{im}, \] independent random effects \[ \beta\sim N\!\left(0,\tfrac{\sigma_G^2}{p}I_p\right),\quad \gamma_k\sim N\!\left(0,\tfrac{\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2}{p}I_p\right),\quad e_i\sim N(0,\sigma_I^2),\quad \varepsilon_{im}\sim N(0,\sigma_\varepsilon^2). \] \(\beta\) main cis-genetic effect, \(\gamma_k\) effect modulated along cell-state axis \(k\), \(\alpha\) \(\eta\) non-genetic effects state covariates, \(e_i\) donor effect shared across cells \(\varepsilon_{im}\) cell-level noise. package \(\sigma_C^2\) \(\sigma_o^2\) denote variance contributed \(c^\top\alpha\) \(o^\top\eta\) (treated random, manuscript).

title: Model
text: Define cis-genetic relatedness (GRM) \[K^G_{ij}=\frac{g_i^\top g_j}{p}.\] two different cells \((,m)\neq(j,n)\), \[ \mathbb{E}(y_{im}y_{jn})=\sigma_G^2K^G_{ij} +\sum_{k=1}^{K_\text{int}}\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2K^G_{ij}c_{imk}c_{jnk} +\sigma_I^2\mathbf 1(=j) +\sum_{k=1}^{K}\sigma_{C,k}^2c_{imk}c_{jnk} +\sum_{l=1}^{L}\sigma_{O,l}^2o_{iml}o_{jnl}. \] residual term \(\sigma_\varepsilon^2\mathbf 1(=j,m=n)\) vanishes distinct cells. every term known kernel times unknown variance, variances estimated ordinary least squares cross-product \(y_{im}y_{jn}\) kernels pairs: \[ y_{im}y_{jn}\sim 1 + K^G_{ij} + \mathbf 1(=j) + \sum_k c_{imk}c_{jnk} + \sum_l o_{iml}o_{jnl} + \sum_{k=1}^{K_\text{int}} K^G_{ij}\,c_{imk}c_{jnk}. \] coefficients variance components \(\hat\sigma^2\) (leading 1 absorbs mean). estimator moment based: likelihood, iteration, remains valid without Gaussian errors (variances may come slightly negative; see Troubleshooting). title: Heritability of Gene Expression Across Cell States and Cell Types
text: gene, let \(y_{im}\) normalized expression cell \(m\) (\(m=1,\dots,M_i\)) individual \(\) (\(=1,\dots,n\)), \(g_i\\mathbb{R}^p\) standardized cis-genotypes (variants within ±500 kb gene), \(c_{im}\\mathbb{R}^K\) cell-state features (e.g. leading within-cell-type principal components) \(o_{im}\) covariates: \[ y_{im}=g_i^\top\beta+(g_i\otimes c_{im})^\top\gamma+c_{im}^\top\alpha+o_{im}^\top\eta+e_i+\varepsilon_{im}, \] \[ \beta\sim N\!\left(0,\sigma_G^2p^{-1}I_p\right),\quad \gamma_k\sim N\!\left(0,\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2p^{-1}I_p\right),\quad e_i\sim N(0,\sigma_I^2),\quad \varepsilon_{im}\sim N(0,\sigma_\varepsilon^2). \] \(\sigma_G^2\) contribution main cis-genetic effects \(\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2\) genetic effects varying along cell-state axis \(k\). \(K^G_{ij}=g_i^\top g_j/p\) cis-GRM, expected product two different cells \[ \mathbb{E}(y_{im}y_{jn})=\sigma_G^2K^G_{ij}+\sum_{k=1}^{K_{\rm int}}\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2K^G_{ij}c_{imk}c_{jnk} +\sigma_I^2\mathbf 1(=j)+\sum_{k=1}^{K}\sigma_{C,k}^2c_{imk}c_{jnk}+\sum_{l=1}^{L}\sigma_{O,l}^2o_{iml}o_{jnl}. \] scHINT regresses \(y_{im}y_{jn}\) kernels. baseline model \[ y_{im}y_{jn}\sim 1+K^G_{ij}+\mathbf 1(=j)+\sum_{k=1}^{K}c_{imk}c_{jnk}+\sum_{l=1}^{L}o_{iml}o_{jnl} \] estimates main genetic component, interaction model adds \(\sum_{k=1}^{K_{\rm int}}K^G_{ij}c_{imk}c_{jnk}\); coefficients \(K^G_{ij}\) \(K^G_{ij}c_{imk}c_{jnk}\) \(\hat\sigma_G^2\) \(\hat\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2\), \(\hat\sigma_{G\times C}^2=\sum_k\hat\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2\). Normalized heritabilities, comparable pseudobulk analyses, exclude cell-level residual denominator: \[ h_G^2=\frac{\sigma_G^2}{\sigma_G^2+\sigma_{G\times C}^2+\sigma_C^2+\sigma_o^2+\sigma_I^2},\qquad h_{G\times C}^2=\frac{\sigma_{G\times C}^2}{\sigma_G^2+\sigma_{G\times C}^2+\sigma_C^2+\sigma_o^2+\sigma_I^2}. \] Several GRMs (e.g. MAF bins) give one \(\sigma_G^2\) one \(\sigma_{G\times C}^2\) per GRM.

title: Heritability of Gene Expression Across Cell States and Cell Types
text: Pseudobulk averages cell-specific variation, cell-level pseudobulk heritability different denominators (Supplementary Note 2). \(m\) cells per individual \(q_{ik}=\alpha_1X_i+\alpha_2Z_{ik}+\beta G_i+I_i+\varepsilon_{ik}\), \[ h^2_{\rm cell}=\frac{\beta^2}{\alpha_1^2+\alpha_2^2+\beta^2+\sigma_I^2+\sigma_\varepsilon^2},\qquad h^2_{\rm PB}=\frac{\beta^2}{\alpha_1^2+\beta^2+\sigma_I^2+(\alpha_2^2+\sigma_\varepsilon^2)/m}. \] scHINT reports h2 (residual \(\sigma_\varepsilon^2\) removed denominator, lower bound pseudobulk value) h2_upper (also removing cell-level covariate variance \(\alpha_2^2\)).
